_comment: Example only. Copy to config/hosts.local.json (git-ignored) and edit. Never put credentials, key paths, agent sockets or tokens here. capabilities drive host selection. port_slots: slot 0 (base ports) is the main checkout and never assigned; slot n adds n*step to every *_PORT. grants are named authority presets for route.py --issue; they state authority, not workflow (a grant's requires adds capability tags it needs, e.g. staging-login: a host where scripts/staging-login.sh can sign in). worker_args: native flags added to every routed worker (auto-approval; anything still needing a decision bubbles up via route.py --blocked).

allowed: the project's issue workflow up to the stop point: commit and push the task's own branch and open ONE draft PR, only once every required check is green

checkpoint pushes: at least every ~60 min of work, push the task's own branch, so no work sits only in the worktree. Push your real commits, or commit the worktree's changes as 'WIP (checkpoint): <issue> [skip ci] [skip deploy]'. A checkpoint is never a PR: that still waits for every required check to be green. Pushed history is never rewritten (force-push stays forbidden): bring main in by merging, not rebasing

to move the task to the other machine only, when the orchestrator asks: one work-in-progress commit of the worktree's changes on the task's own branch, subject 'WIP (host move): <issue> [skip ci] [skip deploy]', pushed to that branch with no PR; the next task starts a worktree at that commit and re-verifies everything before any PR
forbidden: force-push or push any branch but the task's own
anything the project reserves for the parent or human (merge, ready-for-review, status transitions, deploy, staging/provider writes)
git pull/reset/clean/checkout/stash in the main checkout
stop other agents
change security settings
draft-pr.stop_condition: One draft PR targeting main, opened only after the project's required checks are green; report PR URL, branch, exact head SHA and the checks run.

gate.stop_condition: Readiness gate finished once; report pass/fail, the failing checks with excerpts, and the PR head SHA it ran against. Do not fix or rerun beyond the project's own retry rules.

allowed: read the PR diff, the issue and the repo; focus the review on the diff
run focused checks (unit tests, typecheck, lint) in the issue's worktree when needed to confirm or rule out a finding, each wrapped in scripts/heavy
forbidden: edit tracked files, commit, push, comment on GitHub or Linear
start the project's Compose stack or full readiness gate (that's a gate task)
use another task's ports or the main checkout's dev database (no DB-backed integration tests)
anything the project reserves for the parent or human (merge, ready-for-review, status transitions, deploy, staging/provider writes)

review.stop_condition: One review verdict (APPROVE or CHANGES_REQUIRED) with findings tied to file:line, against the PR head SHA.

allowed: git fetch; run the project's staging session helper from the task's own detached worktree at origin/main (no edits)
When explicitly authorized, use the configured synthetic staging test roles through the staging session helper
browse admin, manager, editor and end-user screens and walk the flows the review needs
create test data in the staging test tenant through the app's UI, as the review needs
take screenshots of staging screens with synthetic test data, kept on this host
forbidden: read, print, copy or log a password or a session file's contents; type a password anywhere (the session helper signs in, never you)
sign in to production, or as any account other than the staging test roles
change accounts, users, passwords, invites, tenant, billing or security settings; delete data you didn't create
trigger anything that reaches an external provider from staging (third-party integrations, emails to real addresses)
attach screenshots or session data to Linear or GitHub; report findings as text
edit tracked files, commit, push or open PRs
stop other agents
change security settings
staging-review.stop_condition: Each check recorded as pass or fail with what was seen, every piece of test data created listed, and the session files removed (scripts/staging-login.sh --clear).

desktop.description: Windows desktop, Ubuntu on WSL2. Linux builds, tests and Docker.

mac.description: MacBook Pro. macOS, iOS and Xcode work, or tasks that explicitly request the Mac. Checkouts may be stale.
